leadText:
Chad (Japanese: クリオ Kurio) is a character of the day who appeared in Finding a Legend!. His hometown is Ecruteak City.

Chad met and Goh after hit his Pokémon with . He later explained why he used his and to pose as and introduced them to his grandfather Jaye. They later headed up the Bell Tower, where they encountered a and who were standing guard. After being distracted by Stantler's illusions, the group reached the top of the tower after Goh caught both Stantler and Misdreavus. Everyone called out to Ho-Oh without success, and Chad proceeded to leave with Ash and Goh.
